smoltools

smoltools is a set of small, simple tools that I wanted to find online but ultimately ended up creating myself for personal use.
They're all open source and free to use.

These tools are provided on a best effort basis and come with no warranty.
Use at your own risk.

  • bez: a tool to sample an image along a spline curve
  • svg cropper: a tool to upload an svg and crop it
  • jsongraph: analyzes a JSON object to infer its underlying data schema and visualizes this schema as an interactive directed graph
  • power-renamer: uses the File System API to rename files on your local file system, use search & replace, regex, date variables, numbering, and more
  • image-swiper: swipe through photos to delete the ones you don't want
  • lasso: select PDF text elements with rectangle or lasso selection and copy them in top-down visual order
  • more to come!
